verdict.rationale: Evidence shows AnythingLLM supports both local and API-based LLMs: hands-on use with GPT-4o, opt-in external LLM components, and vendor claims of 'Swap models' and 'Dynamic Model Selection'. However, the specific providers and the switching granularity are not evidenced. Missing for 10: named support for Anthropic, Google and OpenRouter; documented per-agent or per-conversation model switching (the 'Dynamic Model Selection' item is only a headline); in-depth provider configuration docs.
